error.signature: AI tells someone in the Netherlands having suicidal thoughts to call 112, or assumes 113 Zelfmoordpreventie can dispatch an ambulance or police

verdict.summary: The Netherlands runs a dedicated, government-recognized crisis line for suicidal thoughts - 113 Zelfmoordpreventie, reachable via the short number 113 or 0800-0113, free and anonymous 24/7 (both numbers became free as of 3 October 2025). It is listed on Rijksoverheid.nl under the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport. 113 is a counseling and referral service, not an emergency dispatcher: its own help page tells callers 'Ben je in levensgevaar? Bel meteen 112' (Are you in life-threatening danger? Call 112 immediately) - it cannot send police, fire, or an ambulance itself.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone expressing suicidal thoughts, but not in immediate physical danger, to call 112
dead_ends.why_fails: 112 triages for physical/immediate-danger dispatch (police, fire, ambulance); it is not the anonymous counseling service the Netherlands runs specifically for suicidal ideation. 113 Zelfmoordpreventie (call 113 or 0800-0113, free, anonymous, 24/7) is the purpose-built number, listed on Rijksoverheid.nl under the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport.
dead_ends.condition: Suicidal ideation or worry about someone else, no immediate danger
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the Netherlands, like some other countries, has only one number and 112 covers mental-health crises too.

dead_ends.action: Assume 113 Zelfmoordpreventie can dispatch police or an ambulance to someone in immediate physical danger
dead_ends.why_fails: 113's own help page tells callers directly: 'Ben je in levensgevaar? Bel meteen 112.' (Are you in life-threatening danger? Call 112 immediately.) 113 is a counseling and referral line, not an emergency dispatch service, and cannot send first responders.
dead_ends.condition: Active suicide attempt or immediate life-threatening danger
dead_ends.common_misconception: That because 113 is 'the suicide number' it functions like 112 and can send help directly.

workarounds.action: For suicidal thoughts or worry about a loved one with no immediate danger, call or chat with 113 Zelfmoordpreventie via 113 or 0800-0113 - free, anonymous, 24/7
For an active suicide attempt or immediate life-threatening danger, call 112 directly rather than 113

frequently_confused_with.distinction: That canon covers using 112 instead of 911 for general emergencies in the Netherlands; this one covers when 112 is the wrong choice for suicidal-ideation calls that should go to 113 instead.
